page_thesis: This page addresses the false claim that Tesla has released Q2 2026 earnings with 45% margin improvement. Q2 2026 has not concluded (today is May 17, 2026), so these results cannot exist. All evidence points to Q1 2026 earnings already released in April 2026.
confidence_summary: High confidence Q2 2026 earnings NOT released. All reputable sources report Q1 2026 results from April. The claim contradicts the calendar—Q2 ends June 30, 2026.
